requirements.statement: When a nonempty query is entered, the UI shall match NFKC/lowercase literal contiguous query substring in title OR Notes across all Actions, including deferred/completed/dropped and nonempty local proposals, using current raw draft overlays. Query edges are trimmed; whitespace-only query has no results. IDs, catalogs, metadata and collaboration records never participate.

While searching, the UI shall show unique flat matches in canonical action-tree order, without nonmatching ancestors, with existing state and parent/catalog context; rendering, selection normalization, move choices and App context shall agree on visible occurrences.

When a row stops matching, navigation changes, refresh occurs or a write outcome is unknown, the UI shall preserve exact raw drafts and exact pending operation identity; inspector remains independent from explicit selection and reachable without a matching row.

When Search is opened, cleared, closed or replaced by navigation, the UI shall provide named compact controls, composition-safe focus/caret, count/empty feedback and restore prior navigation on close; Escape shall close only outside composition.

The UI shall compute data decisions in pure model functions, normalize before publication, render readonly projections and keep DOM/host/network effects in adapters; search shall cause no writes or per-keystroke reads.
